name: polymer-degradation-measurements
description: Papers that degrade, age, or erode a material and report a measured outcome such as mass loss, mineralisation, or molecular weight change

include.name: measured-outcome
include.pattern: \b(?:mass|weight)[ -](?:loss|losses|remaining|retention|retained)\b|\b(?:residual|remaining) (?:mass|weight)\b|\bmineraliz(?:ation|ed)\b|\bmineralis(?:ation|ed)\b|\bCO2 evolution\b|\bbiogas\b|\bmethane yield\b|\bdegree of disintegration\b|\bcarbonyl index\b|\b(?:molecular weight|molar mass) (?:loss|decrease|reduction|retention)\b
